morgan: Quick: propose switching routing salt from `cohort_hash_v2` -> `routing_salt_v3` for priority routing. Want shadow + owner-preview + small canary. Who takes what?

anya: Console needs a preview toggle + a cohort-diff snapshot endpoint so PMs can see who moves. Gate to owners.

raj: Shadow first at 0.5% for 6h. Key signals: p50/p95 latency, error_rate, kv_cache_hit_rate, token_costs. I'll add PromQLs and bootstrap CI. Example (trimmed):
```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="router",routing_salt=~"(v3|v2)"}[5m])) by (le,routing_salt))
```

sam: Router: implement `x-rw-shadow: true` header. Shadow should not trigger billing/external side-effects; set `x-rw-skip-side-effects`. Use cheap probe where possible.

helen: Quotas: changing hash creates new bucket keys. Plan: read legacy key first, if present use it; write to both during TTL. TTL=24h and run backfill job `quota-migrate-176930` to reconcile. Emit audit events for new keys.

ops-bot: config-snapshot created: s-1769301111 (routing_salt_v3) owners: morgan, helen.

morgan: Rollout: 1) Shadow 0.5% 6h (preview tags) 2) Owner preview in console 3) Canary 2% 1h 4) Ramp 10/50/100% with telemetry gates. Need dashboards, alerts, runbook.

raj: Alerts: channel #ops-alerts. Fire if shadow_error_rate > 0.5% for 5m OR p95_delta > 60ms for 10m OR cost_delta > 10% for 15m.

sam: Failure mode: if p95(v3)-p95(v2) > 60ms for a cohort for 5m, route that cohort back to v2 and mark `failed-rollout`. Add canary abort script.

anya: I'll own console preview and schema for diff snapshots. Putting PR tomorrow.

helen: I'll own quota migration + backfill. Tagging billing + infra for monitoring during TTL.

deploy-bot: canary job scheduled: 1769301300 for routing_salt_v3_canary. Auto-cancel on alert conditions.

morgan: Thanks. Quick sync 09:00 PST tomorrow to finalize runbook. Drop PRs and dashboard links here when ready.
